summary.text: In her January and September 2025 FTC statements, Holyoak described AI as a potential source of consumer benefits, business effectiveness, innovation, and economic growth. On January 30, 2025, she urged the FTC to avoid slowing AI innovation through misguided enforcement and to focus on fraud and understanding the industry. On September 11, 2025, she expressed concern about reports of alarming chatbot interactions with young users and encouraged an FTC study of potential effects on children's and teens' relationships, mental health, and well-being.
